title: Chevon “Rokunowa” MV — Locahun 3D production works
description: Locahun 3D's 3DGS capture data was used in the production of Chevon's “Rokunowa” music video, the opening theme for season 2 of the anime Baki-Dou.
bodyHtml:

Chevon “Rokunowa” Music Video

Opening theme for season 2 of the anime Baki-Dou

Chevon's new single “Rokunowa” — the music video's production incorporated a shot built from Locahun 3D's 3DGS capture data.

Project
Chevon “Rokunowa” MV (opening theme for season 2 of the anime Baki-Dou)
Release
Released 2026.06.19 ／ Music Video (YouTube)
Role
On-location 3D capture and production of an aerial-look shot
Result
An aerial angle achieved with no drone or special equipment, used in the final cut of the music video.
▶ Watch the MV (YouTube)
